notes: Descriptor/value objects and Metal global framework services remain provided by the native framework.
MTLDrawable is supplied by the presentation caller; the bridge invokes its native presentation methods.
Unsupported factory families return errors/nil and do not produce counterfeit backend objects.
Internal NBQueueEntry and NBResourceGroup have no public Metal interface contract.

limitations: macOS runtime builds TARGET_OS_IPHONE=0; iOS-only execution branches are not run.
Device metadata registration uses the real donor and installAnswers with explicit test-only answer-value injection; capability values are not validated by this test.
Metadata checks do not execute GPU functions or the kernel global trace allocator.
